## Public tool handoff

This lane accepts only the six IDs listed in CONTRIBUTING.md. Do not attach private data, secrets, binary bundles or security-sensitive material. Do not request automatic execution or workflow/permission changes.

- Tool ID:
- Base version and exact commit:
- Proposed new version:
- Purpose and bounded change:
- Changed files:
- Source/dependency/license provenance and authority to contribute under MIT:
- Setup and exact test commands:
- Observed results (distinguish tested from untested):
- Known failures and unfinished work:
- Next useful step:
- Rollback:
- Public credit name/handle, or no attribution:

### Contributor checks

- [ ] Synthetic fixtures only; no personal/employer/customer/tax/financial records, private URLs/IDs or credentials.
- [ ] Existing copyright/license notices preserved; third-party dependencies and licenses disclosed.
- [ ] No workflow/permission changes, automatic execution, automatic merging or claims of independent verification.
- [ ] Read CONTRIBUTING.md; source is untrusted until the maintainer's text/privacy/license/safety review and isolated manual tests.

### Maintainer receipt (complete after review)

- Reviewed source/diff and exact commit:
- Privacy/license/unsafe-behavior decision:
- Isolated manual test scope/results and known limitations:
- Reviewed merge decision and version:
- Catalogue/source/download/hash and attribution readback:
